High Cost Oral Atypical Antipsychotics (Bysanti, Caplyta, Cobenfy, Fanapt, Lybalvi, Rexulti, 
Vraylar) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-715196  
Guideline Name 
High Cost Oral Atypical Antipsychotics (Bysanti, Caplyta, Cobenfy, 
Fanapt, Lybalvi, Rexulti, Vraylar)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
10/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Preferred: Vraylar  
Diagnosis 
Schizophrenia  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of schizophrenia  


=== PDF PAGE 824 ===
Page 824 
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient is 13 years of age or older  
 
AND 
 
3 - One of the following:  
 
 3.1 Inadequate response (minimum 30 day trial) or adverse reaction to ONE, or 
contraindication to ALL of the following:  
• 
Aripiprazole  
• 
Clozapine  
• 
Olanzapine  
• 
Quetiapine  
• 
Risperidone  
• 
Ziprasidone  
 
OR 
 
 3.2 One of the following:  
 
  3.2.1 The patient has been receiving treatment with the requested medication, and is new to 
the plan (enrollment effective date within the past 90 days)  
 
OR 
 
  3.2.2 The patient is currently receiving treatment with the requested medication in the 
hospital and must continue upon discharge  
 
Product Name:Non-Preferred: Bysanti, Caplyta, Fanapt, Lybalvi, Rexulti  
Diagnosis 
Schizophrenia  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  


=== PDF PAGE 825 ===
Page 825 
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of schizophrenia  
 
AND 
 
2 - One of the following:  
• 
For Rexulti requests: Patient is 13 years of age or older  
• 
For Bysanti, Caplyta, Fanapt, and Lybalvi requests: Patient is 18 years of age or older  
 
AND 
 
3 - One of the following:  
 
 3.1 Inadequate response (minimum 30 day trial) or adverse reaction to TWO, or 
contraindication to ALL of the following:  
• 
Aripiprazole  
• 
Clozapine  
• 
Olanzapine  
• 
Quetiapine  
• 
Risperidone  
• 
Ziprasidone  
 
OR 
 
 3.2 One of the following:  
 
  3.2.1 The patient has been receiving treatment with the requested medication, and is new to 
the plan (enrollment effective date within the past 90 days)  
 
OR 
 
  3.2.2 The patient is currently receiving treatment with the requested medication in the 
hospital and must continue upon discharge  


=== PDF PAGE 826 ===
Page 826 
 
AND 
 
4 - For Lybalvi requests ONLY, One of the following:  
• 
Patient has a BMI of 30 kg/m2 or greater  
• 
Patient has a BMI of 27 kg/m2 or greater with a weight-related comorbidity (e.g., 
dyslipidemia, hypertension, type 2 diabetes, sleep apnea)  
• 
Patient has a documented history of weight gain of greater than or equal to 10% of 
their baseline weight after initiating antipsychotic medication  
• 
Physician has provided clinical rationale for requiring samidorphan in addition to 
olanzapine therapy  
 
AND 
 
5 - For Bysanti requests ONLY, history of failure to Fanapt  
 
Product Name:Non-Preferred: Cobenfy  
Diagnosis 
Schizophrenia  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of schizophrenia  
 
AND 
 
2 - One of the following:  
 
 2.1 BOTH of the following:  
 
  2.1.1 Inadequate response (minimum 30 day trial), adverse reaction, or contraindication to 
aripiprazole  


=== PDF PAGE 827 ===
Page 827 
 
AND 
 
  2.1.2 Inadequate response (minimum 30 day trial) or adverse reaction to ONE, or 
contraindication to ALL of the following:  
• 
Clozapine  
• 
Olanzapine  
• 
Quetiapine  
• 
Risperidone  
• 
Ziprasidone  
 
OR 
 
 2.2 One of the following:  
 
  2.2.1 The patient has been receiving treatment with the requested medication, and is new to 
the plan (enrollment effective date within the past 90 days)  
 
OR 
 
  2.2.2 The patient is currently receiving treatment with the requested medication in the 
hospital and must continue upon discharge  
 
Product Name:Preferred: Vraylar  
Diagnosis 
Bipolar I Disorder  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of bipolar I disorder  
 
AND 


=== PDF PAGE 828 ===
Page 828 
 
2 - Patient is 10 years of age or older  
 
AND 
 
3 - ONE of the following:  
 
 3.1 Inadequate response (minimum 30 day trial) or adverse reaction to ONE, or 
contraindication to ALL of the following:  
• 
Aripiprazole  
• 
Lamotrigine  
• 
Lithium  
• 
Lurasidone  
• 
Olanzapine  
• 
Risperidone  
• 
Valproate  
 
OR 
 
 3.2 One of the following:  
 
  3.2.1 The patient has been receiving treatment with the requested medication, and is new to 
the plan (enrollment effective date within the past 90 days)  
 
OR 
 
  3.2.2 The patient is currently receiving treatment with requested medication in the hospital 
and must continue upon discharge  
 
Product Name:Non-Preferred: Bysanti, Fanapt, Lybalvi  
Diagnosis 
Bipolar I Disorder  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    


=== PDF PAGE 829 ===
Page 829 
 
1 - Diagnosis of bipolar I disorder  
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient is 18 years of age or older  
 
AND 
 
3 - ONE of the following:  
 
 3.1 Inadequate response (minimum 30 day trial) or adverse reaction to THREE, or 
contraindication to ALL of the following:  
• 
Aripiprazole  
• 
Lamotrigine  
• 
Lithium  
• 
Lurasidone  
• 
Olanzapine  
• 
Risperidone  
• 
Valproate  
 
OR 
 
 3.2 One of the following:  
 
  3.2.1 The patient has been receiving treatment with the requested medication, and is new to 
the plan (enrollment effective date within the past 90 days)  
 
OR 
 
  3.2.2 The patient is currently receiving treatment with requested medication in the hospital 
and must continue upon discharge  
 
AND 
 
4 - For Lybalvi requests ONLY, One of the following:  
• 
Patient has a BMI of 30 kg/m2 or greater  


=== PDF PAGE 830 ===
Page 830 
• 
Patient has a BMI of 27 kg/m2 or greater with a weight-related comorbidity (e.g., 
dyslipidemia, hypertension, type 2 diabetes, sleep apnea)  
• 
Patient has a documented history of weight gain of greater than or equal to 10% of 
their baseline weight after initiating antipsychotic medication  
• 
Physician has provided clinical rationale for requiring samidorphan in addition to 
olanzapine therapy  
 
AND 
 
5 - For Bysanti requests ONLY, history of failure to Fanapt  
 
Product Name:Preferred: Vraylar  
Diagnosis 
Bipolar Depression  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of bipolar depression  
 
AND 
 
2 - ONE of the following:  
 
 2.1 Inadequate response (minimum 30 day trial) or adverse reaction to ONE, or 
contraindication to ALL of the following:  
• 
Lurasidone  
• 
Quetiapine  
• 
Olanzapine plus fluoxetine  
• 
Valproate monotherapy  
• 
Combination therapy (i.e., lithium plus lamotrigine/valproate, lurasidone plus 
lithium/valproate, quetiapine plus lithium/valproate)  
 
OR 
 
 2.2 One of the following:  


=== PDF PAGE 831 ===
Page 831 
 
  2.2.1 The patient has been receiving treatment with the requested medication, and is new to 
the plan (enrollment effective date within the past 90 days)  
 
OR 
 
  2.2.2 The patient is currently receiving treatment with requested medication in the hospital 
and must continue upon discharge  
 
Product Name:Non-Preferred: Caplyta  
Diagnosis 
Bipolar Depression  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of bipolar depression  
 
AND 
 
2 - ONE of the following:  
 
 2.1 Inadequate response (minimum 30 day trial) or adverse reaction to THREE, or 
contraindication to ALL of the following:  
• 
Lurasidone  
• 
Quetiapine  
• 
Olanzapine plus fluoxetine  
• 
Valproate monotherapy  
• 
Combination therapy (i.e., lithium plus lamotrigine/valproate, lurasidone plus 
lithium/valproate, quetiapine plus lithium/valproate)  
 
OR 
 
 2.2 One of the following:  


=== PDF PAGE 832 ===
Page 832 
 
  2.2.1 The patient has been receiving treatment with the requested medication, and is new to 
the plan (enrollment effective date within the past 90 days)  
 
OR 
 
  2.2.2 The patient is currently receiving treatment with requested medication in the hospital 
and must continue upon discharge  
 
Product Name:Preferred: Vraylar  
Diagnosis 
Major Depressive Disorder (MDD)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of one of the following:  
• 
Major depressive disorder (MDD)  
• 
Treatment resistant depression  
 
AND 
 
2 - One of the following:  
 
 2.1 Inadequate response (minimum 30 day trial) or adverse reaction to TWO different 
antidepressants from the following classes (antidepressants MUST be from TWO different 
classes):  
• 
Selective Serotonin Reuptake Inhibitors (SSRIs)  
• 
Serotonin Norepinephrine Reuptake Inhibitors (SNRIs)  
• 
New Generation Antidepressants (e.g., bupropion, mirtazapine, etc)  
• 
Tricyclic Antidepressants (TCAs)  
 
OR 
 
 2.2 One of the following:  


=== PDF PAGE 833 ===
Page 833 
 
  2.2.1 The patient has been receiving treatment with the requested medication, and is new to 
the plan (enrollment effective date within the past 90 days)  
 
OR 
 
  2.2.2 The patient is currently receiving treatment with the requested medication in the 
hospital and must continue upon discharge  
 
Product Name:Non-Preferred: Caplyta, Rexulti  
Diagnosis 
Major Depressive Disorder (MDD)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of Major depressive disorder (MDD)  
 
AND 
 
2 - One of the following:  
 
 2.1 BOTH of the following:  
 
  2.1.1 Inadequate response (minimum 30 day trial) or adverse reaction to TWO different 
antidepressants from the following classes (antidepressants MUST be from TWO different 
classes):  
• 
Selective Serotonin Reuptake Inhibitors (SSRIs)  
• 
Serotonin Norepinephrine Reuptake Inhibitors (SNRIs)  
• 
New Generation Antidepressants (e.g., bupropion, mirtazapine, etc)  
• 
Tricyclic Antidepressants (TCAs)  
 
AND 
 
  2.1.2 Inadequate response (minimum 30 day trial) or adverse reaction to TWO of the 
following:  


=== PDF PAGE 834 ===
Page 834 
• 
aripiprazole  
• 
quetiapine ER  
• 
risperidone  
• 
Augmented therapy (e.g., addition of lithium, another antidepressant from a different 
class, thyroid hormone to current antidepressant regimen)  
 
OR 
 
 2.2 One of the following:  
 
  2.2.1 The patient has been receiving treatment with the requested medication, and is new to 
the plan (enrollment effective date within the past 90 days)  
 
OR 
 
  2.2.2 The patient is currently receiving treatment with the requested medication in the 
hospital and must continue upon discharge  
 
Product Name:Non-Preferred: Rexulti  
Diagnosis 
Agitation Associated With Dementia Due To Alzheimer's Disease  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - The requested medication is being used for treatment of agitation associated with 
dementia due to Alzheimer's disease  
 
Product Name:Preferred: Vraylar; Non-Preferred: Bysanti, Caplyta, Cobenfy, Fanapt, Lybalvi, 
Rexulti  
Diagnosis 
Requests Exceeding Quantity Limit*  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Quantity Limit  


=== PDF PAGE 835 ===
Page 835 
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - ONE of the following:  
 
 1.1 The requested drug must be used for a Food and Drug Administration (FDA)-approved 
indication  
 
OR 
 
 1.2 The use of this drug is supported by information from one of the following appropriate 
compendia of current literature:  
• 
Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved indications and limits  
• 
Published practice guidelines and treatment protocols  
• 
Comparative data evaluating the efficacy, type and frequency of side effects and 
potential drug interactions among alternative products as well as the risks, benefits 
and potential member outcomes  
• 
Drug Facts and Comparisons  
• 
American Hospital Formulary Service Drug Information  
• 
United States Pharmacopeia – Drug Information  
• 
DRUGDEX Information System  
• 
UpToDate  
• 
MicroMedex  
• 
Peer-reviewed medical literature, including randomized clinical trials, outcomes, 
research data and pharmacoeconomic studies  
• 
Other drug reference resources  
 
AND 
 
2 - ONE of the following:  
 
 2.1 The drug is being prescribed within the manufacturer’s published dosing guidelines  
 
OR 
 
 2.2 The requested dose falls within dosing guidelines found in one of the following 
compendia of current literature:  
• 
Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved indications and limits  
• 
Published practice guidelines and treatment protocols  


=== PDF PAGE 836 ===
Page 836 
• 
Comparative data evaluating the efficacy, type and frequency of side effects and 
potential drug interactions among alternative products as well as the risks, benefits 
and potential member outcomes  
• 
Drug Facts and Comparisons  
• 
American Hospital Formulary Service Drug Information  
• 
United States Pharmacopeia – Drug Information  
• 
DRUGDEX Information System  
• 
UpToDate  
• 
MicroMedex  
• 
Peer-reviewed medical literature, including randomized clinical trials, outcomes, 
research data and pharmacoeconomic studies  
• 
Other drug reference resources  
 
AND 
 
3 - The requested dosage cannot be achieved using the plan accepted quantity limit of a 
different dose or formulation  
 
AND 
 
4 - The drug is being prescribed for a medically accepted indication that is recognized as a 
covered benefit by the applicable health plans’ program  
 
AND 
 
5 - Physician has provided rationale for needing to exceed the quantity limit (QL) of one of the 
following:  
• 
For Caplyta requests, QL of 1 capsule/day  
• 
For Cobenfy capsule requests, QL of 2 capsules/day  
• 
For Cobenfy starter pack requests, QL of 2 packs/365 days  
• 
For Bysanti and Fanapt tablet requests, QL of 2 tablets/day  
• 
For Bysanti and Fanapt titration pack requests, QL of 1 pack/180 days  
• 
For Lybalvi requests, QL of 1 tablet/day  
• 
For Rexulti requests, QL of 1 tablet/day  
• 
For Vraylar 0.5 mg, 0.75 mg, 4.5 mg and 6 mg requests, QL of 1 capsule/day  
• 
For Vraylar 1.5 mg and 3 mg requests, QL of 2 capsules/day  
• 
For Vraylar therapy pack requests, 2 packs/365 days  
Notes  
*Prior authorization requests should be reviewed using the above crite
ria. This section is for quantity limit requests only.
